description: ZoneMinder is a free, open-source, full-featured Network Video Recorder (NVR) suite that runs on Linux, supporting IP (RTSP/ONVIF), USB and analog cameras. It handles motion detection, zone-based triggers, recording, and remote viewing through a web console.
name: zoneminder
note: Web console is served over HTTPS on the mapped port (default self-signed cert). Add cameras as an ONVIF or FFMPEG/RTSP source pointed at your camera's stream (e.g. rtsp://IP-CAM/ch0_0.h264). ZoneMinder uses a large shared-memory segment for frame buffers — if recording fails to start, increase the container's shm_size.
title: ZoneMinder
